Plants of the World Online account: Narcissus × alentejanus Fern.Casas.

The native range of this hybrid is Portugal to SW. Spain. It is a bulbous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is N. cavanillesii × N. serotinus.
